findings.title: Complete workflow-authority deletion is accepted as predecessor compatibility
findings.reproduction: At candidate 7641bbceb0fd20286d3e66ea257f6e0036fe4b87, create an initial theory-synthesis intent, preview and save a systematic-review profile change, temporarily remove the protected settings delete trigger, delete all settings rows whose key begins workflow-profile., restore the trigger, and call ResearchIntentService.workspace after restart. Four selection/migration/acceptance rows are removed, yet workspace returns revision 2 with systematic-review because _read_workflow_authority accepts an empty selection history for any intent history. The schema-v10 test creates current governed rows and deletes them, so it cannot distinguish exact legacy bytes from stripped current authority.
findings.required_remediation: Introduce an independently retained activation or bundle binding that makes workflow authority mandatory after its first governed commit, preserve one exact byte-authenticated pre-T02 schema-v10 upgrade path, and add restart tests for complete and partial authority deletion, exact predecessor upgrade, replay, and preservation of predecessor intent bytes.

findings.title: Profile-change preview falsely reports that changed stopping logic remains
findings.reproduction: Start from a theory-synthesis intent with stoppingConditions=['interpretive-saturation']; select systematic-review in IntentWorkspace, whose handler replaces stopping conditions with ['coverage-threshold']; then request an impact preview. The response requires acknowledgement but returns stoppingLogicEffects=['researcher-selected-stopping-remains']. The exact before and after values differ, so the researcher-facing effect is false even though the token now hashes the changed value.
findings.required_remediation: Compute autonomy and stopping effects from exact canonical before/after values and render truthful retained, added, removed, or defaulted changes before acknowledgement. Add service and interactive desktop tests covering theory-to-systematic and a multi-condition transition.

findings.title: Criterion and UI evidence overclaim the native and governed-profile boundaries
findings.reproduction: Compare the frozen evidence with candidate code. The UI-change evidence says the native script proves stale dependency propagation, but the script only previews an ordinary project and never seeds or asserts stale state. The criterion manifest says IntentImpactPreview returns evidence types and per-stage migration dispositions, but its response contract contains neither. It also claims no second desktop profile registry, while IntentWorkspace contains a manually authored fourteen-entry INTENT_FORM_DEFAULTS table used for defaults and warnings.
findings.required_remediation: Make the R02 evidence statements match exact machine-observed behavior, add native assertions if native stale-state coverage is claimed, and remove or canonically generate the remaining fourteen-profile defaults table so governed profile behavior has one authoritative source.
